_source: Hypothesis menu of RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md, one entry per bullet. Starting points for the batch proposer (idea_batch.py), not a script.

ideas.title: Momentum after a change
ideas.diagnosis_signal: misses by days since the last price change: truth above q50 far more often 0-1 days after a change
ideas.change: shift the median or upper edge up when the series changed in the last 1-2 days
tools: models: momentum (beta, k, k_up, k_dn, window, floor)

ideas.title: Per-series calibration or volatility-scaled offsets
ideas.diagnosis_signal: interval misses concentrated in a few series or groups; coverage far from 0.80 by group
ideas.change: calibrate per smaller group, or scale interval offsets by each series' own volatility (exp_002 lowered geomean)
tools: models: vol_tail (per-series volatility-aware band, lookback, m)

ideas.title: Group-specific models
ideas.diagnosis_signal: the per-model skill table shows which base model wins in which group
ideas.change: combine base models with weights that follow recent loss within each group

ideas.title: Leading signals from other collectors
ideas.diagnosis_signal: candidate leading signals: the same GPU in another collector moving 1-4 days earlier
ideas.change: use the leader series' recent move to shift the forecast; check the correlation is not driven by a handful of steps

ideas.title: Provider-mix effects
ideas.diagnosis_signal: misses by provider-count changes: medians move when providers enter or leave
tools: models: composition (rho, thresh, k_rev: partial reversion after a provider-count change)

ideas.title: Trend in the median
ideas.diagnosis_signal: bias: the median is systematically below or above the truth
ideas.change: shift the median by a share of the recent mean log change

ideas.title: Pooled quantile regression
ideas.diagnosis_signal: misses depend on days since change, recent volatility, class and horizon in a shared way
ideas.change: a pooled quantile-regression model across series with those features, trained only on rows before the origin
tools: needs a new model file; not available to a spec-only proposer
